statement: Bharani's ruling planet (Vimshottari dasha lord) is Venus; its presiding deity is Yama (god of death and dharma), symbolized by the yoni. It is traditionally associated with bearing difficulty with discipline, and transformation through what must be carried.
editorial_note: Reflects a widely-repeated interpretation found throughout standard Vedic astrological literature, exemplified by (not claimed as a verbatim quotation of) the cited source.
